user.title: Add a profile
user.description:
A profile is a Music Assistant account and the Home Assistant users who may use it: the card then shows that account's library, music sources and players.

Create the token **while logged in to Music Assistant as that account** (Settings → your user → API tokens): Music Assistant applies the filters of the user the token belongs to.

A Home Assistant user can use several profiles (e.g. one user shared by every tablet of the home): each card then names its profile (card option `profile`), or the user picks one per output in the card's output panel. Users on no profile keep the integration's main account.

data.name: Profile name
data.ma_token: Music Assistant API token of this account

data_description.name: Shown in the card's output panel; also the value of the card's `profile` option.
data_description.ha_user: The Home Assistant user who gets this profile by default (a user has one default profile at most).
data_description.ha_users: Other Home Assistant users who may use this profile: from their card's `profile` option, or by picking it for an output in the card's output panel (e.g. a shared tablet starting a child's own music in their room).
data_description.default_player: Player selected when this profile opens the card on a device where no player was chosen yet.
data_description.allowed_players: Outputs the default user of this profile may use, in the card and through their actions — also when they use another profile. None ticked: every output (or the player filter of their Music Assistant user, if it has one).

missing_players.title: Music Assistant players that no longer exist

confirm.title: Delete the media players of vanished players
confirm.description:
Music Assistant no longer knows these players, but their media players are still in Home Assistant (unavailable):

{players}

This usually happens when a device comes back under another identifier: Music Assistant then sees a new player (for Squeezelite, a different MAC address — set a fixed MAC address in the player's settings to avoid it), or for browser web players.

Tick the media players to delete. Untick a speaker that is only switched off: it will come back by itself when it reconnects.

abort.no_missing_players: Every player is back: nothing to delete.

transfer_queue.name: Transfer queue
transfer_queue.description: Moves what a My Music Library player is playing (same track, same position) to one or more other players. With several targets, the first one leads a group of them all; the source stops.
